23931:
Mira Katherine Sorvino (/ˈmiːrə sɔːrˈviːnoʊ/; born September 28, 1967) is an American actress. She won the Academy Award and Golden Globe for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in Woody Allen's Mighty Aphrodite (1995).

She also starred in the films Romy and Michele's High School Reunion (1997), Mimic (1997), Lulu on the Bridge (1998), The Replacement Killers (1998), Summer of Sam (1999), Gods and Generals (2003), Like Dandelion Dust (2009), and Sound of Freedom (2023).
Manhattan, New York City, New York, USA
85883:
Shruti Haasan (born 28 January, 1986) is an Indian actress, playback singer, and musician who predominantly works in Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi cinema. She is the daughter of actors Kamal Haasan and Sarika Thakur.

After working as a child playback singer and making a brief appearance in *Hey Ram* (2000), she made her adult acting debut in the Hindi action thriller *Luck* (2009). She appeared in *Anaganaga O Dheerudu* (2011) and *7 Aum Arivu* (2011), winning the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut – South.
114299: Ryohei Kimura is a Japanese voice actor.
230011: Radha Mohan (Born 20 November 1965) is a Tamil movie director. He has, till date, directed five films, out of which four of them are critically acclaimed and box-office hits. A good friend of actor-producer Prakash Raj, he has directed four films for Prakash Raj's Duet films: Azhagiya Theeye, Mozhi, Abhiyum Naanum and Payanam. He was born in Nagercoil. Director Dharani is his best friend.
544891: Suseenthiran is an Indian film director and screenwriter. He rose to fame with the film Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu, which marks his directorial debut.
1103227: Harish Uthaman is an Indian film actor who has appeared in Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam language films. He made his debut portraying the lead role in Thaa (2010), before playing villain in Gouravam, Pandiya Naadu and Meagamann.
1210235: Sonalee Kulkarni Benodekar is an Indian actress who mainly acts in Marathi and Hindi-language films. She is the recipient of several awards including two Filmfare Awards Marathi. She is noted for her lavani dance song, "Apsara Aali" in the Marathi film Natarang.
1523579:
Shin Hye-sun is a South Korean actress managed by YNK Entertainment (YNK 엔터테인먼트). Inspired by Won Bin’s performance in the drama “Autumn Tale,” Shin entered the Film Art program at Sejong University and made her acting debut in the 2012 television drama “School 2013” (학교 2013).

Her accolades began to accumulate, with the 2016 Scene Stealer Festival awarding her Rookie of the Year. Subsequent years saw her triumphant at the KBS Drama Awards and SBS Drama Awards, securing Excellence and Top Excellence accolades for her performances. In 2021, she was honoured with Close-up Award at the Korean Film Producers Association Awards.
